**SECTION D: ESSAY (10 marks)**

*Write an essay of about 200-250 words on ONE of the following topics.*

**Topic 1**

Many young boys and girls are dropping out of school to play football, and some of them dream of becoming richer than the players they call "Stars" in just a few years. The topic asks whether this is good for them and requires concrete examples and illustrations.

questions.enonce_markdown: Write an essay of 200 to 250 words giving your opinion on this question : is it good for young people to drop out of school to play football? Support your ideas with concrete examples. *[10 pts]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un essai argumentatif suit trois temps : une introduction qui présente le sujet et annonce la position (*thesis statement*), un développement de deux ou trois paragraphes où chaque idée est illustrée par un exemple concret, et une conclusion qui reprend la position sans idée nouvelle ; les connecteurs (*firstly*, *moreover*, *however*, *in conclusion*) balisent le raisonnement et la longueur demandée doit être respectée.

Le sujet est un essai d'opinion (*Do you think ... ?*). Le plan retenu : introduction avec la position, deux arguments contre l'abandon de l'école, un paragraphe de concession, puis conclusion.

**Essai modèle (environ 229 mots)**

Nowadays, many boys and girls abandon school to chase a football career. Some even imagine that, within a few years, they will be richer than the "stars" they admire. In my opinion, this choice is not good for them, and I will explain why.

Firstly, football is a very narrow road. Thousands of teenagers join academies and street teams, but only a handful sign a professional contract. The others return home without a diploma, without a trade and often without savings. A boy who left school at fifteen to train every day may find himself, at twenty, unable to read a work contract or to start a small business.

Secondly, a football career is short and fragile. One serious injury during a match can end the dream in a single afternoon. A player who has studied can still become a coach, a physiotherapist or a sports journalist. One who has not has nothing to fall back on.

However, I admit that talent deserves encouragement. Some young people do succeed, and their stories inspire others. But even these champions needed discipline, and good clubs now ask their young players to attend classes.

In conclusion, football should remain a passion and not a reason to quit school. Young people should train after classes, keep their books open and treat the game as one chance among others, not as the only one.

**Éléments valorisés au barème** : une introduction qui présente le sujet et la position ; des arguments classés (*firstly*, *secondly*, *however*, *in conclusion*) ; des exemples concrets et vraisemblables (académies, blessure, reconversion) ; une conclusion qui ferme sans idée nouvelle ; une langue correcte. Un essai défendant la position inverse reste valable s'il est argumenté de la même façon.

### Piège à éviter
Ne raconte pas une histoire à la place d'un raisonnement : un essai d'opinion exige une position claire dès l'introduction, des arguments distincts et des exemples, pas une succession d'anecdotes.

### Conseil
Garde 5 minutes pour compter tes mots paragraphe par paragraphe (environ 40 mots pour l'introduction, 60 par argument, 40 pour la conclusion) : tu restes dans la fourchette de 200 à 250 mots sans recompter tout le texte.
